$comment: MCP servers for this repo. Committed deliberately — it contains no secrets.
The Supabase token is read from the SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN environment
variable rather than written here. A personal access token is account-wide
across every Supabase project you own, so it must never sit in a tracked
file: current_token.txt is already in this repository's history for exactly
--project-ref pins the server to the Texas Sons database. The token can
still reach your other projects; this narrows what the tools will touch.
Windows needs `cmd /c` in front of npx for stdio MCP servers.
Cloudflare is deliberately absent. CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and
CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are already in .env.local and already drive cfFetch in
server.ts, so `npm run cf` reaches Pages with no new credential and no
restart. Add the remote MCP server only if you want it in conversation:
